notice: Whitelist extension for the LimitBreak Creator Token Transfer Validator that allows Zharta renting vaults to return the NFTs they hold, for collections whose transfers are gated by a whitelist ruleset. It only enables withdrawals: a vault is whitelisted only while it owns its token, so deposits into vaults remain blocked.

register_vaults(address,uint256[]).notice: Register the vaults of a renting contract for the given token ids, whether they are already deployed or not.

isWhitelisted(address,address).notice: Check if an account is a registered Zharta vault for the given collection, currently owning its token.

title: Zharta Vault Whitelist Extension
author: [Zharta](https://zharta.io/)
details: Implements `IWhitelistExtension.isWhitelisted(collection, account)`, which the validator queries for accounts not whitelisted by address or codehash. Vaults are minimal proxies (EIP-1167) deployed by the renting contract with CREATE2, using the token id as salt, so a vault address can only hold a vault deployed by the renting contract. As the validator doesn't provide the token id, vaults must be registered beforehand: anyone can register the vaults of a renting contract for a set of token ids, as their addresses are provided by the renting contract (`tokenid_to_vault`). The code and storage of an account are not used to identify vaults, as other contracts can replicate both. A registered vault is whitelisted only while it owns its token, which holds during a withdrawal (the validator runs before the transfer) but not during a deposit. The whitelisting applies to the account, for any transfer validated meanwhile, but the renting protocol can only make a vault transfer its own token. The validator calls extensions without try/catch for every collection sharing the list, so `isWhitelisted` must never revert. Markets are immutable and the contract has no owner.

register_vaults(address,uint256[]).details: Permissionless, as the vault addresses are provided by the renting contract. Registering a vault again has no effect.

params.renting: The address of the renting contract of the market.
params.token_ids: The ids of the tokens whose vaults are registered.

isWhitelisted(address,address).details: Called by the validator. Never reverts.

params.collection: The address of the collection whose transfer is being validated.
params.account: The address being checked by the validator.

returns._0: True if the account is a registered vault of a market for the collection and owns its token, False otherwise.
